protected_acceptance_map.title: Production root cause is preserved
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Tests and release evidence distinguish P2-V0.23.44 from P2-V0.23.43: lineage naming/ledger identity are already fixed; this slice addresses only successful Git ref mutation propagation and exact partial-publication replay.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Branch-create propagation is bounded
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: After an exact successful branch-create response, an immediately absent ref read can be reconciled only from a matching one-shot acknowledgment for the same repository/branch/base head.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Commit-ref propagation is bounded
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: After an exact successful non-force ref PATCH response, an immediate absent or exact-prior-head read can be reconciled only from the matching one-shot acknowledgment for the same repository/branch/new commit.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Unexpected heads remain fail-closed
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: If a live ref read returns a head different from both the acknowledgment's exact prior state and exact new state, no acknowledgment is applied and delivery fails.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Acknowledgments are one-shot and process-local
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Acknowledgments are consumed at most once, are not durable state, do not survive client/process recreation and cannot authorize another repository or branch.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Ordinary exact partial commit recovers
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: For ordinary delivery, a canonical branch already advanced by a prior partial attempt to the exact accepted-lineage commit may recover from branch `BRANCH_CONFLICT` only through successful existing `commit_files()` lineage replay.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Greenfield exact partial commit recovers identically
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Greenfield delivery uses the same branch/commit reconciliation helper and exact replay rule after its unchanged delivery-base classification.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Arbitrary branch conflicts still fail
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: A canonical branch at a different commit, lineage or parent cannot be adopted, reset or overwritten by the recovery path.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Clean delivery remains unchanged
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: A normal non-stale provider path still creates the canonical lineage branch, exact commit, PR and Preview under existing provider actions and persists the exact lineage-scoped durable record.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Durable replay remains first
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: An existing exact durable delivery record returns before provider mutation and is unaffected by this release.

protected_acceptance_map.title: No authority expansion
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Diff/tests prove no new credential, provider, repository, arbitrary-ref, force-update, delete, merge, production, model, command, network, execution-profile or automatic-REVIEW authority.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Protected release gates pass
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The exact spec passes structure validation, authentic DSPy SpecCritic/SpecCompiler and strict compiled-plan validation before semantic implementation. Focused provider/delivery regressions, full API regression, Bounded Autonomy, Workstream Spec Validation and P2 CI pass on exact reviewed heads.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Exact production deployment is verified
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The exact merged API source reaches production READY with normal preflights, `/health` and `/ready` HTTP 200, and exact-deployment warning/error/fatal scans reviewed.

protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Frozen run `a64d56b7-ad42-42ad-9562-891783363f4a` remains REVIEW revision 12 with `last_failure_code=null` and retries replacement lineage `src:001736ab731e243956cf78ede7a0087d2b81595f1008568850eac1e9acc3e809`. Acceptance must prove: - the existing canonical lineage branch is reconciled without reset/delete/force update; - its exact accepted-lineage commit is reused or verified; - a new exact GitHub PR is created/read for that lineage; - a bounded Vercel Preview is created/read under existing semantics; - a distinct exact durable `SOURCE_DELIVERY` record is persisted for the replacement lineage; - prior reviewed branch `parallax/0e20392b-a64d56b7` and QA PR #1 remain unchanged; - no `GREENFIELD_BASELINE_MISMATCH`, `BRANCH_NOT_FOUND`, `SOURCE_MISMATCH`, prior-branch `BRANCH_CONFLICT` or provider conflict remains as the delivery stop; - the Engineering Run remains at human REVIEW revision 12. Any genuinely later independent blocker is recorded separately rather than weakening this contract.

critique: The partial GitHub publication recovery defect exposed by production acceptance of P2-V0.23.43 is not weakening exact-lineage source authority, provider least privilege, canonical branch identity, durable delivery replay, default-branch protection, Preview-only delivery or the human REVIEW ceiling. A delivery request that receives an exact successful GitHub ref mutation response must not fail solely because the immediately following read is temporarily stale. If an earlier attempt already advanced the canonical lineage-scoped branch to the exact accepted Parallax lineage commit but failed before durable delivery persistence, a later retry may reconcile that exact partial commit and continue. Any ambiguous, externally modified or differently authored branch head remains a hard failure.
